name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Intermediate or Equivalent
benefit:
1. Financial Assistance: ₹10,000/-. 1. Intended Use: To encourage Brahmin students to continue their education.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** The amount of Financial Assistance granted will be credited through online to the SB Accounts of the students.
_eligibility_text: 1. The student and his/her parents should belong to the Brahmin community. 1. The parents should reside in Andhra Pradesh. 1. The student's parents/guardians should stay in Andhra Pradesh. 1. The student should be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS). 1. The annual family income of Parents/guardians should not be more than ₹3,00,000/- (Rupees Three lakhs only). 1. The student should be pursuing a regular course in a School/College/Institute/University for the Academic year 2019-20. 1. The student should have passed in all the subjects till the previous year of study (i.e., students who do not have any backlogs in their previous semesters/years are only eligible). 1. The students availing the benefit from Archaka Welfare Trust are eligible under this scheme, in addition to the assistance they get from Archaka Welfare Trust.
